ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a vertical line, and the base is a horizontal line. There is a right-angle mark at the lower left corner, indicating that the vertical line is perpendicular to the horizontal base line. At the lower left corner there is also a slanted line inclined upward to the right, with 35° marked beside it, indicating that the angle between this rising slanted line and the vertical line is 35°. Another slanted line extends from near the left side downward to the right and intersects the rising slanted line, with 70° marked at the intersection point. Angle 2 is located between the left vertical line and this slanted line extending downward to the right. Reasoning: Because the vertical line is perpendicular to the horizontal base, the angle between them is 90°. The angle between the rising slanted line and the vertical line is 35°, so the angle between the rising slanted line and the horizontal line is 90° - 35° = 55°. The angle between the two slanted lines is 70°, so the angle between the slanted line downward to the right and the horizontal line is 70° - 55° = 15°, that is, it is inclined 15° relative to the horizontal line. Angle 2 is the angle between this slanted line and the vertical line, and the vertical line is perpendicular to the horizontal line, so angle 2 is complementary to 15°: m∠2 = 90° - 15° = 75°.

method.method_draft: 先看图：左下角的直角标记说明竖线与底边水平线互相垂直；左下角标出的35°是竖线与上升斜线的夹角，所以这条斜线与水平线的夹角是90°-35°=55°。再看两条斜线的交点，图上给出它们之间的角为70°，因此向右下的那条斜线与水平线只差55°-70°=15°。因为竖线与水平线垂直，所以角2与15°互余，故m∠2=90°-15°=75°。
method.CoT_raw:

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the left-side right-angle markers, the 35° marking at the lower-left between the vertical and rising diagonal, the 70° marking at the intersection of the two slanted lines, and the placement of angle 2 on the left vertical intersection.
planner_metadata.text_role: The text only asks for the measure of ∠2, so it identifies the target angle and tells us the answer should be a numeric angle measure.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use perpendicular-line complements, angle subtraction from a known diagonal inclination, and the fact that an angle with the vertical is the complement of its angle with the horizontal.
